shortDescription: Retrieve information about one or more oVirt/RHV hosts

options.name: all_content
options.description: If I(true) all the attributes of the hosts should be included in the response.

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: cluster_version
options.description: Filter the hosts based on the cluster version.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(yes) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch only IDs of nested entity. It doesn't fetch multiple levels of nested attributes. Only the attributes of the current entity. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes). This parameter is deprecated and replaced by C(follow).

options.name: follow
options.description: List of linked entities, which should be fetched along with the main entity. This parameter replaces usage of C(fetch_nested) and C(nested_attributes). All follow parameters can be found at following url: https://ovirt.github.io/ovirt-engine-api-model/master/#types/host/links_summary

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true). This parameter is deprecated and replaced by C(follow).

options.name: pattern
options.description: Search term which is accepted by oVirt/RHV search backend. For example to search host X from datacenter Y use following pattern: name=X and datacenter=Y
